form.label: MyDemoTicket - Audit
form.description: Audit trail of the MyDemoTicket ticket system (sourcetype mydemoticket:audit). Every search is filtered on the selected tenant; tenant roles only see their own index anyway.

search.query: (index=mdt_* OR index=main) sourcetype="mydemoticket:audit" tenant="$tenant$" | fields _time tenant action actor role outcome object_type object_id source ip request_id details.*
(index=mdt_* OR index=main) sourcetype="mydemoticket:audit" | stats count by tenant | sort tenant
| search action="ticket.state_change" | eval transition=coalesce('details.from',"?")." -> ".coalesce('details.to',"?") | stats count by tenant transition | sort - count

| search (action="auth.login" outcome="failure") OR outcome="denied" | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen values(ip) as ip by tenant action actor outcome | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - count
| search action="webhook.delivery" | timechart count by outcome
| stats count dc(action) as distinct_actions values(role) as role by tenant actor | sort - count | head 10
| sort - _time | head 200 | table _time tenant action outcome actor role object_type object_id source ip request_id
